adjudication.rationale: The diff shows client-side validation in `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` creating a Zod schema with a uniqueness `refine` (lines ~26-29) while the server schema `addGuests.schema.ts` only validates `guests` as `z.array(z.string().email())` with no uniqueness constraint. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` filters out emails already on the booking and blacklisted emails, but does not dedupe duplicates within the submitted `guests` array itself. Therefore an input like `["a@b.com","a@b.com"]` can pass server validation and result in `createMany` inserting duplicate attendee rows (unless an unseen DB constraint prevents it). This is a real correctness issue and a divergence between client and server validation.
